body: Moved from docs/tasks/P1-instant-play-and-worst-bugs.md on 6 Nov 2026 (the task files hold the definition only; how far a task is lives on the board). **Status 2026-10-22: engine part done, tests green, walked on the emulator (same evidence file).** Offline a song that is not downloaded is not tried and nothing is skipped; Next goes to the next downloaded song or says so; the next song is preloaded only when it can play; a waiting song starts by itself when the network returns (`networkChanged`). Greyed rows done too (`lib/features/common/playability.dart`: offline, songs not on the phone are dimmed with a cloud-off mark in album/playlist lists, search rows and the Top result; `test/features/offline_rows_test.dart`). Not done: queue sheet rows, the "once per session" explanation (the player's own notice covers a tap), covers offline (done in P1-10).
